# Issue #20: feat(ui): Build React 18 Extension Popup Layout and Real-Time Sync Status Tracker

- **State**: `CLOSED`
- **Labels**: `type: feature`, `area: ui`
- **URL**: `https://github.com/Inkesk-Dozing/LeetLogger/issues/20`

---

Build a modern React 18 browser action popup layout showing extension status and recent sync activity.



## Objectives

- Glassmorphic UI container with modern dark mode styling (`src/ui/popup/App.tsx`, `src/ui/styles/global.css`).

- Real-time connection status indicator (GitHub token validity, linked repository, current branch).

- Recent submissions list displaying problem difficulty badges, submission timestamps, and direct GitHub commit links.

- One-click trigger buttons for manual queue sync and navigation to options dashboard.



## Tasks

- [x] Create React 18 popup dashboard layout.

- [x] Implement connection health and target repository display.

- [x] Render recent submissions list with direct commit links.
